definitions.gloss: water surface, surface of the water
definitions.explanation: The top layer or surface of a body of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{水面|すいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かんで→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A fish came up to the surface of the water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{水面|すいめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{波立|なみだ}って→波立つ：28434_namidatsu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The water surface is rippling in the wind.

examples.japanese: {水面|すいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}って→映る：12964_utsuru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The moon was reflected on the water surface.

notes:
{水面|すいめん} refers to the surface of any body of water—lakes, rivers, oceans, pools, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水面|すいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: to float on the water surface
- {水面|すいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧: to be reflected on the water
- {水面|すいめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{波立|なみだ}つ→波立つ：28434_namidatsu⟧: the water surface ripples
- ⟦{水面下|すいめんか}→水面下：21954_suimenka⟧: below the surface (literally and figuratively)

USAGE:
⟦{水面下|すいめんか}→水面下：21954_suimenka⟧ (below the surface) is often used to describe hidden activities or negotiations happening behind the scenes.
